title: pair-proof/v1
description: targets/<id>/review/pair-proofs/<a>--<b>--<direction>--<stamp>-<author>.yaml (F26-R8, F26-T16; D-9 v3.39): a contributor's kernel-checked settlement of one open direction of a review pair. A proof shows the direction's first candidate implies the second; a refutation is an instance, a natural number at which the first candidate's claim holds and the second's fails, never a proof that the two statements differ. `lean` is the whole file: the gate's template for the direction (`opn_gate.pair_proofs.template`) with the contributor's helper declarations and proof written into its two marked regions, every other byte the template's. The gate checks it before the merge and the review job re-checks it and writes the pair record and its exhibit after; this record never changes a pair by itself. Append-only; versioned, never edited (D-34).

target.description: the target the record is filed under

a.description: the pair's first candidate, the lexically smaller id, as pair/v1 names it

direction.description: `forward` settles a implies b, `backward` b implies a, as pair/v1 names them

kind.description: `proof`, the implication proved; `refutation`, an instance where the direction's first claim holds and its second fails

case.description: null for a proof; for a refutation the instance, in the review's own case form (`review_lean.Case.key`), with the claims read at n and no probe

statement_hashes.description: each candidate's statement_hash as its candidate/v1 record carries it, so the settlement is bound to the texts it was checked against

lean.description: the whole file, the template with its two regions filled

author.description: the ledger identity (pseudonym) credited, the token's own

models.description: the models that helped, each named (v3.31); empty for a person's work

id.description: a candidate's id, as candidate/v1 and pair/v1 name it
